In a letter dated July 17, 2026, the director of the Mines and Geology Department informed the State government that a representation submitted by Ballari-based petitioners Tapal Ekambaram and Tapal Ganesh, forwarded by the Union Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change, should be placed before the Justice Dhulia Committee, constituted by the Supreme Court to examine issues relating to OMC and the inter-State forest boundary dispute. The department said it was not the competent authority to decide the issues raised in the representation and recommended that the matter be forwarded to the Central Empowered Committee (CEC) and the Justice Dhulia Committee for an appropriate decision.

reranked_evidence.snippet: You are here: Home → News → Crime & Punishment → 2026 07 25 → **Article 2044805**. Crime & Punishment of Saturday, 25 July 2026. Konate denied the charge of defiling a child under 16. The Wa High Court has sentenced a 42-year-old self-styled Imam, Ilyasu Konate, to 10 years’ imprisonment with hard labour for defiling a seven-year-old boy in Kabenya, a suburb of Wa. The conviction follows a swift prosecution led by Principal State Attorney Abdul Saeed Shakur, who revealed that the convict exploited his position as a trusted neighbour to commit the crime. On January 17, 2026, Konate lured the victim, the child’s sister, and his own stepdaughter onto his motorbike under the pretext of taking them for a ride. Although Konate denied the charge of defiling a child under 16, claiming no assault occurred, the court rejected his defence. He affirmed that the prosecution will relentlessly pursue offenders to ensure the full rigour of the law is applied, offering the victim’s family long-awaited relief as Konate begins his sentence immediately.

reranked_evidence.title: Former Venezuelan president Maduro gets June 2027 court date for drug charges - USA Today
reranked_evidence.snippet: Ousted Venezuelan leader Nicolás Maduro and his wife, Cilia Flores, will go on trial June 1, 2027, as they fight drug trafficking charges, a federal judge announced at a July 22 court hearing in New York City. The ousted former president of Venezuela is facing charges that he helped others transport thousands of tons of cocaine into the United States as part of a narco-terrorism conspiracy, and that he also committed other drug- and gun-related crimes. At the July 22 hearing, U.S. District Judge Alvin Hellerstein set trial for Maduro and Flores on June 1, 2027. Prosecutors said in a July 21 court filing that they had jointly agreed with Maduro to request a June 2027 trial date at the hearing the following day, and on deadlines beginning in September for Maduro to file motions challenging the case and for prosecutors to provide him with relevant case documents.
